verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of per-channel, keyword, or schedule-based notification controls in Teams. The docs cover developer platform, Graph API, webhooks and connectors, none of which address user notification tuning. Community reports describe the opposite: no channel muting or unsubscribe, notifications impossible to fully silence, and channel notifications easy to miss. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is an applicable axis with no supporting evidence, so 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
